dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mr. Brown, have you ever missed a flight?
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn, hæv juː ˈɛvər ˈmɪst ə ˈflaɪt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, once. Last December, I was flying home to Canada.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈwʌns. ˈlæst dɪˈsɛmbər, aɪ wʌz ˈflaɪɪŋ ˈhoʊm tə ˈkænədə.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: My first flight was delayed, so I missed my connecting flight in Tokyo.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈflaɪt wʌz dɪˈleɪd, soʊ aɪ ˈmɪst maɪ kəˈnɛktɪŋ ˈflaɪt ɪn ˈtoʊkioʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no! What did you have to do?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈwʌt dɪd juː ˈhæf tə ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I had to stay overnight in Tokyo. There were no more flights that day.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhæd tə ˈsteɪ ˌoʊvərˈnaɪt ɪn ˈtoʊkioʊ. ðɛr wɜːr ˈnoʊ ˈmɔːr ˈflaɪts ðæt ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Did you have to pay for a hotel?
dialogue.reading: dɪd juː ˈhæf tə ˈpeɪ fər ə hoʊˈtɛl?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, I didn't have to pay. The airline gave me a voucher for a hotel.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈhæf tə ˈpeɪ. ði ˈɛrlaɪn ˈɡeɪv miː ə ˈvaʊtʃər fər ə hoʊˈtɛl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: A little. I had to wait for twenty hours, but the hotel was very comfortable!
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl. aɪ ˈhæd tə ˈweɪt fər ˈtwɛnti ˈaʊərz, bʌt ðə hoʊˈtɛl wʌz ˈvɛri ˈkʌmftərbəl!
